Countries.Name: Canada
Countries.Limit_Summary: 24 hours a week off campus while classes are in session

Course_Types.Label: College or university program
Course_Types.Detail: Full-time, or part-time in your final semester

Job_Types.Label: Off-campus job
Job_Types.Detail: Any employer off your school's campus.

Job_Types.Label: On-campus job
Job_Types.Detail: Your school, or a business on campus. No hour limit.

Job_Types.Label: Remote, employer outside Canada
Job_Types.Detail: Working from Canada for an employer abroad. Doesn't count toward the 24 hours.
Job_Types.Warning: Keep your contract handy as proof the employer is outside Canada.

Job_Types.Label: Required co-op or placement
Job_Types.Detail: Only if your program requires it. Tracked separately.
Job_Types.Warning: A job called "internship" isn't a required placement unless your program says so.

Job_Types.Label: Gig or self-employed
Job_Types.Detail: Delivery, rideshare, freelance. Counts toward the 24 hours.
Job_Types.Warning: Count all the time you spend earning, including time online waiting for orders, unless you're sure it's unpaid.

Countries.Check_Conditions_Text: Check the conditions printed on your study permit.

Sources.Title: IRCC: Work off campus as an international student
IRCC Help Centre: working during scheduled breaks

How_We_Count: Up to 24 hours of off-campus work in any 7 days in a row. IRCC doesn't say when a week starts, so HourGuard checks every 7-day stretch.
Scheduled breaks of 7 days or more have no limit. Shorter breaks count as term time.
Unlimited hours stop after 150 back-to-back break days, and after 180 unlimited days in a calendar year.
On-campus work, remote work for an employer outside Canada and required placements are tracked separately.
No work before your program starts.
Planned shifts count as soon as you add them, so you're warned before you agree to too much.

Countries.Name: Australia
Countries.Limit_Summary: 48 hours a fortnight while your course is in session

Course_Types.Label: Coursework degree, diploma or VET
Course_Types.Detail: Bachelor's, master's by coursework, diploma, ELICOS

Course_Types.Label: Master's by research or PhD
Course_Types.Detail: No limit once your course has started
Course_Types.Note: Research students have no work limit once their course starts. HourGuard still keeps your records.

Job_Types.Label: Job
Job_Types.Detail: Any job, on or off campus, paid or unpaid.

Job_Types.Label: Mandatory course placement
Job_Types.Detail: Only if it's a required part of your course as registered on CRICOS.
Job_Types.Warning: Elective placements, and hours beyond what your course requires, count toward the 48 hours.

Job_Types.Label: Gig or self-employed
Job_Types.Detail: Delivery, rideshare, freelance. Counts toward the 48 hours.

Countries.Check_Conditions_Text: Check your visa conditions in VEVO.

Sources.Title: UNE: Work conditions for student visa holders

How_We_Count: Up to 48 hours in any fortnight while your course is in session. A fortnight is 14 days starting on a Monday.
Fortnights roll every week: weeks 2 and 3 are a fortnight too, so HourGuard checks every pair of weeks.
Scheduled course breaks have no limit.
Unpaid work counts. Mandatory placements registered on CRICOS are tracked separately.
No work before your course starts.
Planned shifts count as soon as you add them, so you're warned before you agree to too much.

Countries.Name: United Kingdom
Countries.Limit_Summary: 20 hours a week in term time (10 below degree level)

Course_Types.Label: Taught master's
Course_Types.Note: Universities usually treat your summer dissertation period as term time. Only add it as a break if your university says so.

Course_Types.Label: PhD or research degree
Course_Types.Detail: Term time is set by your university
Course_Types.Note: Research students are usually in term time all year. Only add approved annual leave as a break.

Job_Types.Label: Job (employed)
Job_Types.Detail: Any employer, including your university. Voluntary work counts too.

Job_Types.Label: Assessed course placement
Job_Types.Detail: Assessed, and an integral part of your course. Tracked separately.

Job_Types.Label: Gig or self-employed
Job_Types.Detail: Delivery and ride apps, freelance, selling through apps.
Job_Types.Warning: Student visa holders can't be self-employed. Delivery and ride apps usually count as self-employment.

Countries.Check_Conditions_Text: Check the work conditions on your eVisa.

Sources.Title: UKCISA: Navigating work and study with a Student visa
University of Warwick: Working on the Student route
GOV.UK: View and prove your immigration status

How_We_Count: Up to 20 hours a week in term time at degree level, or 10 below degree level.
A week runs Monday to Sunday. There's no averaging: a long week can't be balanced by a short one.
Outside term time (official vacations) you can work full-time.
Self-employment, including delivery and ride apps, isn't allowed at all.
Assessed placements that are part of your course are tracked separately.
Planned shifts count as soon as you add them, so you're warned before you agree to too much.

Changes.Title: Off-campus limit raised to 24 hours a week
Changes.Body: IRCC raised the off-campus limit during academic sessions from 20 to 24 hours a week.

Changes.Title: Work limit set at 48 hours a fortnight
Changes.Body: Student visa holders can work up to 48 hours a fortnight while their course is in session.
